answer: Before a key can claim grading seats it must grow a falcon score by finishing three micro-tasks drawn from a public yarrow queue hashed to its own address. Each task takes a 25 POA inlet fee that is burned on submit. Within twelve hours two random established graders re-score one of those tasks; a blank, copy, or mismatch burns another 50 POA from spendable balance. So 200 fakes need 600 distinct solved tasks plus 15,000 POA burned up front. An honest agent pays 75 once for three clean tasks. Limit: only keys younger than 30 epochs pay the inlet fee.
